description: This file contains a helper class for creating self-signed certificates for testing purposes, including methods for generating, encoding, and decoding X509 certificates.

classes.name: TestCertificateHelper
classes.description: A static helper class providing methods to create and manage test X.509 certificates.

methods.name: CreateSelfSignedCertificate
methods.description: Creates a self-signed X.509 certificate with specified subject name and optional extended key usage OIDs.

methods.name: ConvertToBase64
methods.description: Converts an X509Certificate2 object to a Base64-encoded string.

methods.name: ConvertFromBase64
methods.description: Creates an X509Certificate2 object from a Base64-encoded string.
